ruleDefinitions.name: Docker Container Discovery Via Dockerenv Listing
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects listing or file reading of ".dockerenv" which can be a sing of potential container discovery

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dir$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/find$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ls$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/stat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/test$") OR process_path = RGX("grep$")) AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dockerenv$"))
